_comment: Values below are NOT frozen. They are configuration awaiting P1/P2 approval and registration. Nothing in contracts/schemas may default to them. Set registered=true only with a real decision_date and reference.

week_definition.note: P4 stated choice of UTC ISO weeks. No in-repo registry holds a conflicting entry, but no external registry has been checked and P1's approval date/time and decision reference are not supplied. Unfrozen.

sealed_window.note: Assumed UTC calendar days, inclusive, all sensors. Awaiting P2 Q3 coverage rules and P1/P2 approval.

week_53_minimum.note: P1: unfrozen. Do not register or hard-code any minimum (including three) until both blockers clear.

footprint_certification.note: Whole-footprint completeness is conditional on P2's documented certification (Q3 response not available to P4-B).
